planDigest.mismatchBehavior: Stop before executing any task and regenerate this sidecar from the rewritten plan.

scope: One foundation plan with four execution phases, three blocking go/no-go gates, and Phase D final acceptance.

tasks.subject: Establish Python 3.12 project metadata and the canonical lock
tasks.observableResult: A Hatchling src project syncs from uv.lock, the launcher export is lock-derived, and the installed package imports normally.
tasks.expectedResult: All commands exit 0, the export is unchanged after regeneration, Python is 3.12, and import scoutmb resolves from the installed package.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Correct project groups or markers and regenerate uv.lock; never hand-edit exported pins.

tasks.subject: Add green quality and lock CI jobs
tasks.observableResult: lint-format, types, lock, and a narrow unit-contract job pass on every pull request.
tasks.expectedResult: All commands exit 0; CI uses Python 3.12 and locked sync and contains no automated live-service job.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Scope temporary mypy overrides to legacy modules only; do not disable checks for src/scoutmb or merge a red job.

tasks.subject: Enforce offline-by-default tests and application egress policy
tasks.observableResult: Every default Python and browser path blocks non-loopback egress before private data can leave the process.
tasks.expectedResult: Both commands exit 0, sentinels record zero non-loopback requests, and injected external URLs raise ExternalNetworkBlocked.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Disable the new network adapter and repair the missing guard; never allowlist the real host in default tests.

tasks.subject: Create synthetic factories and a repository privacy tripwire
tasks.observableResult: Committed factories cover identity and payload edge cases with synthetic values and fail the suite on likely private data.
tasks.expectedResult: Both commands exit 0 and the scanner reports private-data findings: 0 without echoing source text.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Quarantine the fixture outside the repository and repair the factory or scanner; never allowlist real values.

tasks.subject: Add optional private-corpus verification
tasks.observableResult: Local raw_data can supplement synthetic contracts offline and produces aggregate redacted output, while absence is an explicit skip.
tasks.expectedResult: Tests pass and the corpus command prints private corpus: PASS or private corpus: SKIPPED (not present), with no names, IDs, tokens, or URLs.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Stop on redaction failure, remove only tool-created summaries, preserve raw_data untouched, and repair before rerunning.

tasks.subject: Characterize every input and PDF extraction contract
tasks.observableResult: Table-driven tests pin every supported input, PDF decode, attendee CSV, and failure contract.
tasks.expectedResult: The command exits 0, every locked matrix row is named, and optional PDF/OpenCV libraries are not imported eagerly.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Correct mistaken expectations from observed legacy output; do not change production parsing in this task.

tasks.subject: Characterize ScoutingEvent and browser-session behavior against a local fake
tasks.observableResult: A loopback fake pins observed session, payload, redirect, schema, retry, terminal-error, and request-count behavior.
tasks.expectedResult: The command exits 0, fake request counts match, and the external-request sentinel remains zero.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Extend the local fake with the missing observed shape; never capture a live response in an automated test.

tasks.subject: Characterize inference, artifacts, interfaces, and baseline performance
tasks.observableResult: The remaining behavior matrix and a redacted reproducible performance baseline cover inference, outputs, entry points, requests, memory, and sizes.
commands: uv run python tools/measure_baseline.py --corpus synthetic --output build/baseline.json
tasks.expectedResult: Tests pass and build/baseline.json contains machine, corpus, samples, request, memory, and size data without private values or placeholders.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Keep wall time descriptive, fix missing observables, and do not move production code until the correctness matrix is complete.

tasks.subject: Characterization go/no-go
tasks.observableResult: One reproducible offline privacy-safe Phase A evidence run records GO or blocks Phase B with NO-GO.
commands: uv run python tools/check_private_data.py tests build/baseline.json
tasks.expectedResult: GO only when all commands pass, all matrix rows are present, and there are zero network or privacy findings.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Record NO-GO, stop, return failure to its Phase A task, preserve legacy behavior, and rerun the full gate without waivers.

tasks.subject: Introduce package boundaries and compatibility entry points
tasks.observableResult: The scoutmb package has inward dependencies, legacy entry points delegate, and no first-party code mutates sys.path.
tasks.expectedResult: All commands pass, help contracts match, and installed imports work without repository-root assumptions.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Keep the compatibility wrapper active, move one symbol group back, and restore parity without path mutation or duplicate logic.

tasks.subject: Establish typed domain, clocks, errors, configuration, and DTO versions
tasks.observableResult: Pure typed models cover domain state, errors, versioned DTOs, UTC wall time, and monotonic deadlines.
commands: uv run pytest tests/unit/domain tests/unit/test_clocks.py tests/contracts/test_dto_versions.py -q
uv run mypy --strict src/scoutmb/domain src/scoutmb/ports src/scoutmb/contracts
tasks.expectedResult: Both commands pass and domain tests require no filesystem, network, browser, UI, or system clock.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Remove incomplete DTOs from composition and keep boundary dictionaries behind the legacy adapter until strict checks pass.

tasks.subject: Move input and PDF work behind ports with parity
tasks.observableResult: Input and PDF adapters match legacy behavior while a core-only install avoids PDF/OpenCV imports.
commands: uv run pytest tests/parity/test_input_adapter_parity.py tests/parity/test_pdf_adapter_parity.py tests/packaging/test_core_imports.py -q
tasks.expectedResult: The command passes, all A6 projections match, and core-only import succeeds without optional libraries.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Select the legacy adapter and fix one matrix mismatch at a time; do not make optional libraries core dependencies.

tasks.subject: Implement the ScoutingEvent session gateway and schema-drift boundary
tasks.observableResult: One adapter owns sessions, URL validation, schema profiles, redaction, and drift diagnostics behind a typed port.
tasks.expectedResult: The command passes, observed profiles validate, drift fails closed, and diagnostics expose no sensitive payload data.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Keep the legacy local-fake adapter selected and add a reviewed schema profile; never use permissive parsing.

tasks.subject: Add bounded acquisition retries, deadlines, checkpoints, and a circuit breaker
tasks.observableResult: Acquisition has bounded attempts/time, deduplication, resumable checkpoints, circuit breaking, and complete resource closure.
tasks.expectedResult: The command passes, request counts are bounded and deduplicated, and resource tracking reaches zero on every outcome.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Disable the new acquisition service, retain checkpoints, restore the characterized adapter, and never raise budgets to hide leaks.

tasks.subject: Replace name identity with fail-closed upstream IDs and per-run UUIDv4
tasks.observableResult: Same-named attendees remain distinct, missing IDs fail closed, and full UUIDv4 identifiers are unique and scoped to each run.
tasks.expectedResult: Both commands pass, UUID version is 4, cross-run IDs are unlinkable, and scans find no upstream IDs or tokens.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Fail the affected run before publication and preserve only redacted diagnostics; never synthesize identity from names or stable digests.

tasks.subject: Version schemas/templates and publish each artifact atomically
tasks.observableResult: Versioned CSV, JSON, HTML, and email artifacts atomically replace prior files and exclude sensitive adapter state.
commands: uv run pytest tests/contracts/test_artifact_schemas.py tests/unit/artifacts/test_atomic_file.py tests/privacy/test_artifacts.py -q
tasks.expectedResult: The command passes, reviewed goldens match, failures preserve prior bytes, and no temporary or sensitive artifact remains.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Keep the prior schema active and failed output in private staging; never partially overwrite a published artifact.

tasks.subject: Publish multi-file report generations atomically
tasks.observableResult: Readers see one complete manifest-addressed report generation before or after publication, never mixed files.
tasks.expectedResult: The command passes at every injected failure point and the active manifest always references a complete hash-valid generation.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Leave the prior manifest active and quarantine incomplete staging; never merge generation directories.

tasks.subject: Introduce durable run state and lifespan-owned job supervision
tasks.observableResult: One supervisor owns legal run transitions, resumable checkpoints, bounded workers, cancellation, recovery, and shutdown.
tasks.expectedResult: The command passes, no child resource survives, and restart produces a documented terminal or resumable state.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Stop new jobs, persist checkpoints, cancel owned children within grace, and keep the legacy adapter selectable until tests pass.

tasks.subject: Secure the loopback web boundary and stream uploads safely
tasks.observableResult: The lifespan-created loopback app enforces authentication, Host/Origin/CSRF, CSP, path containment, streaming limits, parser budgets, and redaction.
tasks.expectedResult: The command passes, invalid requests are rejected before mutation, memory is bounded, and valid local flows retain parity.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Keep the previous UI loopback-only or disabled and repair the boundary; never bypass authentication for desktop convenience.

tasks.subject: Compose CLI, web, and desktop entry points with port-zero rendezvous
tasks.observableResult: All entry points share feature services and use an authenticated OS-assigned port rendezvous without rebind races.
tasks.expectedResult: Both commands pass, parallel launches receive distinct assigned ports, and doctor reports no live network or path mutation.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Abort the attempted launch without killing unrelated processes and restore the prior entry adapter while fixing composition.

tasks.subject: Prove clean package and copied-release startup
tasks.observableResult: Wheel, sdist, and a clean copied release root start without the repository and include all package data.
tasks.expectedResult: Both commands pass, dist artifacts exist, and clean installs answer the offline health probe with repository paths unavailable.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Keep the last working copy manifest, correct build/package-data rules, and never fall back to repository files.

tasks.subject: Identity, output, and runtime go/no-go
tasks.observableResult: One complete Phase B parity, privacy, security, lifecycle, failure-injection, and packaging run records GO or blocks Phase C.
commands: uv run pytest tests/architecture tests/compat tests/parity tests/contracts tests/privacy tests/security tests/integration tests/packaging -m "not live_service" -q
uv run python tools/check_private_data.py build/test-artifacts dist
tasks.expectedResult: GO only when all commands pass with correct identity, atomic outputs, zero leaks/resources/security failures, and clean packages.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Record NO-GO, restore the relevant compatibility adapter, preserve failed generations privately, and rerun the full gate without waivers.

tasks.subject: Resolve installed data roots, permissions, retention, backup, and restore
tasks.observableResult: Platform data roots, secure permissions, locked retention classes, and staged private backup/restore are enforced.
tasks.expectedResult: The command passes, cleanup selects only eligible data, protected data is unchanged, and restore validates before activation.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Stop cleanup and activation, retain backup and active root, quarantine invalid restore staging, and require explicit retry.

tasks.subject: Add OS-backed ownership, single-instance rendezvous, and activation
tasks.observableResult: One launcher owns the install while a second authenticated launch activates the existing instance and exits.
tasks.expectedResult: The command passes repeatedly: one owner starts, followers activate and exit 0, and no unrelated process is signaled.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: If ownership is not provable, do not launch or break the lock; preserve evidence and show recovery guidance.

tasks.subject: Implement copy-only SHA-256 migration and activation marker
tasks.observableResult: A throwaway legacy root migrates by resumable collision-safe hash-verified copy and leaves the source untouched.
commands: uv run scoutmb migrate --source build/legacy-root --destination build/new-root --dry-run
tasks.expectedResult: Both commands pass, the dry-run manifest is deterministic, source hashes remain identical, and activation references a complete verified inventory.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Keep source and active destination untouched, retain staging and manifest, and resume from the last verified item.

tasks.subject: Detect split-brain writes and preserve recovery snapshots
tasks.observableResult: Divergent legacy/new writes pause destructive work and preserve both versions with hashes and provenance.
tasks.expectedResult: The command passes and every divergence produces bounded diagnostics and complete protected snapshots without changing active data.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Freeze cleanup and publication, retain both snapshots indefinitely, require explicit reconciliation, and rescan before resuming.

tasks.subject: Version durable state and enforce the activation compatibility tuple
tasks.observableResult: Versioned durable state and one activation tuple validate executable, state generation, capabilities, and protocol before startup.
tasks.expectedResult: The command passes, incompatible tuples never launch, and failed state conversion preserves prior executable and state.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Atomically reactivate the last-known-good tuple and retain failed staged state as a protected snapshot; never downgrade in place.

tasks.subject: Harden downloads, archives, disk budgets, and capability cache ownership
tasks.observableResult: Streamed downloads, safe extraction, disk reserve, and cache ownership reject hostile or unaffordable payloads before activation.
commands: uv run pytest tests/launcher/test_downloader.py tests/security/test_safe_extract.py tests/launcher/test_disk_budget.py tests/launcher/test_capability_cache.py -q
tasks.expectedResult: The command passes; hostile, oversized, mismatched, and disk-full cases preserve current install and protected cache data.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Delete only verified unreferenced staging through the cache service and retry after disk or network recovery.

tasks.subject: Install releases transactionally with readiness proof and rollback
tasks.observableResult: Versioned releases activate only after nonce-bound readiness and roll executable and state back together on any failure.
tasks.expectedResult: The command passes, current.json is always valid old/new state, and rollback restarts the prior app/state offline.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Restore the last-known-good pointer and state atomically and retain failed staging within budget; never mutate a working release.

tasks.subject: Migration and release go/no-go
tasks.observableResult: A throwaway live-layout copy completes migration, N-to-N+1, forced rollback, and N offline restart with GO or blocks Phase D.
commands: uv run pytest tests/storage tests/migration tests/launcher tests/contracts/test_state_compatibility.py tests/integration/test_backup_restore.py tests/integration/test_activation_tuple.py -q
uv run python tools/rehearse_upgrade.py --legacy-root build/gate3/legacy --work-root build/gate3/work --sequence N,N+1,N
tasks.expectedResult: GO only when source hashes, ownership, collision/split-brain preservation, disk/interruption safety, offline rollback, and redaction all pass.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Record NO-GO, preserve evidence and snapshots, reactivate N, return failure to its C task, and never migrate the live install.

tasks.subject: Split core, acquisition, browser, and PDF capability payloads
tasks.observableResult: Core and three optional capabilities have separate closures, manifests, compatibility, cache, install state, and rollback behavior.
tasks.expectedResult: Both commands pass, manifests/hashes are deterministic, core starts offline, and optional features remain unavailable until installed.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Keep the prior compatible capability, quarantine failed staging, and leave the feature truthfully unavailable.

tasks.subject: Implement platform browser selection and readiness
tasks.observableResult: Windows uses Edge, Chrome, managed Chromium; macOS uses Chrome, managed Chromium; Safari is explicit and experimental only.
tasks.expectedResult: The command passes for platform matrices, supported engines complete local-fake readiness, and experimental choices are truthful.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Fall back only in documented order, retain the prior managed browser, and leave acquisition unavailable if readiness fails.

tasks.subject: Build and verify sub-18 MB Windows and macOS installers
tasks.observableResult: Supported Windows 11 x64 and macOS 14+ arm64 installers are at most 18 MB and support clean install plus offline restart.
commands: uv run python tools/build_installers.py --platform all --output dist/installers
tasks.expectedResult: All commands pass on supported runners, each installer is at most 18 MB, optional payloads are absent, and restart works with egress denied.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Do not publish the candidate, remove only build staging, keep last-known-good installers, and reduce closure instead of raising the budget.

tasks.subject: Add redacted diagnostics and an offline OpenTelemetry seam
tasks.observableResult: Structured diagnostics and a bounded local telemetry spool run with a no-op exporter and no network by default.
tasks.expectedResult: Both commands pass, telemetry creates only bounded local records, the network sentinel is zero, and diagnostics contain no sensitive values.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Disable the exporter and remove corrupt spool segments through the spool manager without touching application runs.

tasks.subject: Produce release supply-chain evidence
tasks.observableResult: One evidence bundle contains vulnerability/license/secret results, SBOMs, hashes, source revision, manifests, and clean-build metadata.
commands: uv run python tools/build_release_evidence.py --artifacts dist --output build/evidence
tasks.expectedResult: All commands pass, evidence binds exact hashes/revision, no unreviewed finding remains, and signing status is deferred-internal.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Block publication, keep the prior clean bundle, repair the dependency or artifact, rebuild, and regenerate all evidence together.

tasks.subject: Lock measured resource and performance limits
tasks.observableResult: Every release resource and performance limit has a measured value, unit, rationale, safe range, and enforced failure behavior.
commands: uv run python tools/measure_baseline.py --corpus synthetic --repetitions 5 --compare build/baseline.json --output build/release-baseline.json
tasks.expectedResult: Both commands pass on the controlled runner, all limits are non-placeholder, and no hard or wall-time threshold regresses.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Reject the candidate, keep prior limits, profile on the same machine class, and require new evidence before widening a limit.

tasks.subject: Final acceptance, documentation, and legacy retirement
tasks.observableResult: All three gates and Phase D evidence are green, documented offline operations work, and redundant legacy logic is retired behind compatibility entry points.
commands: uv run python tools/verify_release.py --evidence build/evidence --installers dist/installers --capabilities build/capabilities
tasks.expectedResult: Every command passes and no stale path, sensitive artifact, egress escape, unresolved decision, or unverified release artifact remains.
tasks.recoveryBehavior: Do not publish or migrate live data; restore the last-known-good release bundle, fix the owning task, and rerun D7 in full.
